description: Comments on a public post or video, newest first, paginated with limit and cursor. Instagram only. Credits: 1 per item returned, and an empty result is free (25 a day per account, then 1 credit each). Input: url.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call's meta.

limit.description: Items to return, up to 50; a larger value is lowered to 50, and free accounts get at most 5 (meta.limit_capped reports it). Credits are charged per item returned, and an empty result is free (25 a day per account, then 1 credit each).

url.description: Full public URL of the post, video, profile or page.

name: get_comments

data.description: The endpoint's payload: one object, or an array for list calls.

meta.description: count, limit and next_cursor on list calls; credits_charged, credits_remaining and cache (hit or miss) on billed calls; limit_clamped when fewer items were requested upstream than the balance could cover; limit_capped when a free account's request was lowered to the free tier's 5-item ceiling.

summary: Comments on a public post or video, newest first, paginated with limit and cursor.
title: Read comments on a post
